title: Solve any linear equation
hook: Distribute, collect, move, divide: one routine for every linear equation, even with fractions.

steps.prompt: From memory: what are the four moves for solving a linear equation like 3(x − 2) + 4 = 2x + 9?
steps.answer: Distribute, collect the x terms on one side, move the numbers to the other side, then divide by the coefficient of x.

steps.why: Subtract 2x from both sides: x − 2 = 9, so x = 11. Check: 3(9) + 4 = 31 and 2(11) + 9 = 31.
